neural_population.scope: all named hermaphrodite neurons; not all 473 cells

neuromuscular_population.efficacy_policy: explicit functional parameters required; EM counts are not signs or conductances
neuromuscular_population.electrical_coupling_policy: retain anatomical arrays; implement with muscle membrane voltage, never replace with mechanical strain

neuron_dynamics_next.candidate: pinned c302 C1 conductance-based single compartments and graded synapses
neuron_dynamics_next.data_reader: fixed Cook arrays directly assembled in NEURON using pinned C1 exported components; no default spreadsheet
neuron_dynamics_next.parameter_provenance: keep C1 BlindGuess parameters labelled as assumptions
neuron_dynamics_next.default_demo_currents: remove c302_Full PLM stimulation and 5pA unphysiological offset from the main condition
neuron_dynamics_next.state: persistent; do not reconstruct from a sliding four-second window
neuron_dynamics_next.chemical_sign_policy: GABA-labelled sources inhibitory, all other sources explicitly assumed excitatory; per-cell table archived

mechanical_body.drive_units: dimensionless signed pre-filter drive, not mV, calcium or force
mechanical_body.causal_order: accepted physical state -> strain observation -> command -> muscle filter; new muscle state affects following physical interval

planar_projection.name: provisional_symmetric_rank_bins
planar_projection.mapping: average L/R slots at each ordinal rank and hold across two neighboring segments
planar_projection.missing_MVL24: zero contribution with denominator two retained
assumptions: ordinal rank used as nominal longitudinal bin
planar_projection.requires_3D_reference: claims about distinct left-right muscle roles or torsion

sensory_and_feedback_next.mechanical_feedback: implemented rectified ipsilateral bending contrast to18 DB/VB cells; nominal anterior200um fields and500pA/strain are assumptions
sensory_and_feedback_next.corollary_discharge: network motor-state pathway; distinct from mechanical measurements
